answer: Prove each agent lives on a distinct machine by timing round trips to several far-apart verifiers, like a raven flying between cedar groves: a real node has a unique latency fingerprint, while ten thousand clones on one rack all answer with the same opal-smooth delay. A farm must rent machines spread across continents to fake it. Limit: latency can be proxied and jittery, so use it only as one signal beside stake.
